title: Eventual vanishing of one finite type quasi-coherent module map
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I\to\mathrm{CRing} a diagram, and S=\varprojlim_{k\in I}\operatorname{Spec}(R_k) an affine limit. Let f:X_i\to\operatorname{Spec}(R_i) be quasi-compact [def-pc-scheme], and j\ge i. Put X_j=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}\operatorname{Spec}(R_j) and X=X_i\times_{\operatorname{Spec}(R_i)}S [def-pc-base-change]. Let F_j be a finite type quasi-coherent module on X_j and G_j a finitely presented quasi-coherent module on X_j [pqf-def-coherent]. If a module map \delta_j:F_j\to G_j has zero tensor pullback to X, then there exist j\prime\ge j such that its tensor pullback to X_{j\prime} is zero. No Noetherianity hypothesis or finite-presentation hypothesis on f is required.

source.place: Limits, Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR (3), first proof; Algebra Tag 05N7 (3), finite-generator vanishing argument

proof.text: The quasi-compact morphism f has quasi-compact source X_i since its target is affine. Choose a finite affine open cover of X_i. Inverse images of these opens in X_j, later X_l, and X are affine and cover, since all base change maps come from affine morphisms. The restricted source module is finitely generated and the restricted target module is finitely presented. A module map is zero if it is zero on every open of this cover.

proof.text: Fix a. By [lem-weil-pbc-spec-colimit-limit] applied to the directed system (R_{j'})_{j'\ge i}, \operatorname{Spec}(\varinjlim R_{j'}) with the induced maps is a limit of the system (S_{j'}); by uniqueness of limits it is identified with S=\operatorname{Spec}R compatibly with the projections, so, taking global sections, R=\varinjlim_{j'}R_{j'} as rings. Since A^a\otimes_{R_i}- commutes with colimits, B^a=\varinjlim_{j'\ge j}B^a_{j'}. On U^a_j the source F_j corresponds to a finitely generated B^a_j-module M with generators s_1,\dots,s_n, and the target G_j to a finitely presented B^a_j-module N=\operatorname{coker}(P:(B^a_j)^m\to(B^a_j)^p); the pullbacks to U^a_{j'} and U^a_X correspond to M\otimes B^a_{j'}, N\otimes B^a_{j'}=\operatorname{coker}(P\otimes B^a_{j'}) and similarly over B^a (right exactness of tensor product). Lift each \delta_j(s_k) to v_k\in(B^a_j)^p. Vanishing of the base change to X means that the image of v_k in (B^a)^p is P c_k for some c_k\in(B^a)^m. By clause (1) of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise] for the directed set \{j'\ge j\} (a filtered category) and directedness, all finitely many entries of all c_k lift to some B^a_{j'}, giving \tilde c_k; each entry of v_k-P\tilde c_k\in(B^a_{j'})^p maps to 0 in B^a, so by clause (2) of the same statement (comparison with 0) it vanishes in some later B^a_{j''}, and by directedness one j'' serves for all of them. Then \delta_{j''}(s_k\otimes1)=0 for all k, and since the s_k\otimes1 generate M\otimes B^a_{j''}, \delta_{j''} vanishes on U^a_{j''}.

proof.text: Choose a common upper bound of the finitely many stages obtained for the affine cover. A zero linear map remains zero under tensor pullback. At this common stage the restricted map is therefore zero on every affine of the pulled-back cover, and hence the whole sheaf map is zero. This concerns one fixed map rather than a finite family of relations.

No eventual-vanishing theorem for scheme module maps. Sheaf.Algebra.FinitePresentationColimit gives the ring-level affine case but not its scheme transport/gluing. Blueprint searches for 01ZR and module map zero find no matching blueprint node.

lean.statement: theorem finitePresentation_zero_map_descent {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cone (R.op ⋙ Scheme.Spec)) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsAffine c.pt] (i : I) {Xi : Scheme.{u}} (f : Xi ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) [QuasiCompact f] (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j) (F G : (pullback f (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Modules) (hF_ft : F.IsFiniteType) (hF_qc : F.IsQuasicoherent) (hG_fp : G.IsFinitePresentation) (hG_qc : G.IsQuasicoherent) (δ : F ⟶ G) (hδ : (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (c.π.app (op i))) (Over.homMk (c.π.app (op j)) (c.w (homOfLE hij).op))).map δ = 0) : ∃ (j' : I) (hjj' : j ≤ j'), (Scheme.Modules.moduleBaseChange f (T := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))) (T' := Over.mk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE (hij.trans hjj'))))) (Over.homMk (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hjj'))) (by dsimp; rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← R.map_comp]; rfl))).map δ = 0
